messages.subject: Dashboard with long titles
parts:
Hi,

I would like to create a dashboard with a long title. Using a long text in the title parameter of  dashboardHeader leads to the title text appearing in the sidebar. How I can make a longer title? I was thinking of putting my long title right to the sidebar-toogle icon. But how do that?

Thanks in advance, Sigbert
